name: The High Elder's Request

angles.text: The cult's interest in anchor pylons and the involvement of an enigmatic skypriest at the western watchtower present a troubling development for priests studying divine or ritual manipulation.

faq.answer: High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong is a leader located in Valanaar. Faced with coordinated cult activity against the region's watchtowers, he seeks capable adventurers to pursue promising leads on the cult's true intentions.
Valanaar serves as a settlement or sanctuary where High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong is stationed, coordinating defenses and investigating cult incursions against local anchor pylons and towers.

Coordinated attacks struck both the western and eastern watchtowers. Defenders suspect these assaults were not random raids, but deliberate maneuvers meant to target or manipulate the nearby anchor pylons.

Anchor pylons are critical defensive or regional structures. Intelligence gathered from the assault on the western watchtower suggests a hostile cult is specifically attempting to interfere with or subvert them.
A skypriest was involved in the incident at the western watchtower. The details reported from that encounter led leadership to deduce the cult's broader scheme regarding the anchor pylons.
faq.q: Who was the skypriest at the western watchtower?

faq.answer: An aggressive cult has orchestrated simultaneous strikes against the region's watchtowers. Their exact nature and deeper motives remain under investigation as High Elder Shadowsong works to unravel their plans.
faq.q: What cult is targeting the watchtowers?

sections.body: Recent coordinated assaults on both the western and eastern watchtowers have revealed a troubling pattern. What initially seemed like scattered skirmishes now points toward a calculated offensive directed against local anchor pylons. Reports from the confrontation with a skypriest at the western watchtower first exposed the cult's interest in these structures, prompting authorities to treat the towers' defense as a matter of urgent concern.
sections.title: Trouble at the Watchtowers

sections.body: Recognizing the escalating threat to the anchor pylons, leadership directs adventurers to speak directly with High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. Holding a promising lead regarding the cult's movement, the High Elder seeks experienced allies prepared to track the enemy and counter whatever ritual or sabotage they intend to unleash.
sections.title: Audience in Valanaar

summary: The High Elder's Request sends adventurers to consult with High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar following coordinated assaults on the region's watchtowers. Reports from the western watchtower indicate that a hostile cult is targeting the local anchor pylons.
